review: Listen to me for a second. I am the person everybody in the parish calls when somebody dies. Eleven families this year. I found this album looking for something to play at my mother-in-law's wake and it has not come off since. "Their Empty Chair" is what a house is actually like the week after, and "The Casserole Dish" — we do that, we have always done that, and I have never once been able to say why it matters. This says why. I have sent this to eleven grieving families and not one of them has asked me what it was, they just say thank you. My father died on a Tuesday and I planned the whole funeral before I cried. You need anything, you call me. Nobody calls me.
